title: Group Anagrams
prompt: Given an array of strings, group the anagrams together and return the grouped lists.
hints: Use a normalized key so all anagrams share the same bucket.
You can sort each word or count characters.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
prompt: Return the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
hints: A sliding window lets you expand and shrink efficiently.
Track the last seen index of each character.
